ruleReviews.reviewedCase: Calendar owns morning/evening seasons: Holy Thursday Lauds remains Lenten; Easter Lauds is Easter Time despite Triduum overlap. Aggregate day labels remain unchanged.
An obligatory memorial excludes competing memorials; Mother of the Church suppresses Boniface on June 5, 2028. Immaculate Heart reduction is preserved.
Sunday/solemnity concurrence uses higher precedence, retaining today on equality; Easter Sunday-season and US Epiphany regression cases are rule-derived.
US weekday obligation policy is separate from celebration rank, including Saturday/Monday exceptions and the configured Ascension profile.
ruleReviews.limitation: Annual calendars are contextual evidence, not direct decree verification. Transfer effects can remain Unknown; local law and dispensations are not modeled.

ruleReviews.reviewedCase: Opening Alleluia is rendered outside Lent and omitted through the pre-Easter Triduum, including Lauds' alternative introduction; the Invitatory verse is unchanged.
ruleReviews.limitation: The opening review does not certify all proper Triduum elements. Participation-dependent omissions are reviewed separately under HOUR-05.

ruleReviews.reviewedCase: Calendar owns weeks and octave ordinals. Holy Thursday retains weekday psalms/proper antiphons; Easter octave Lauds/Vespers override the background cycle. Approved-book review is pending.
ruleReviews.seasonalReview: Lenten Sunday Vespers II replaces Revelation with 1 Peter 2:21-24. Palm Sunday Vespers I/II retains Week II; First Vespers retains Philippians.

assignmentReview.limitation: Structural validation does not certify exact citations or verse limits. Existing assignments still require the applicable approved Hours books.

ruleReviews.reviewedCase: GILH 137 prescribes Timothy at Epiphany/Transfiguration Vespers. Use existing 1 Timothy 3:16 reference in both phases; full First Vespers psalm sets remain unverified.
ruleReviews.limitation: GILH identifies the biblical book, not the exact verse limits. The existing Transfiguration citation is retained; approved-proper verification remains pending.

ruleReviews.reviewedCase: GILH 92 requires Regina Caeli in Easter Time, including Easter Sunday Compline; other seasonal Marian suggestions are not mandatory. Full Compline propers remain open.
ruleReviews.octavePsalmodyReview: Calendar's eight-day Easter octave uses a complete Sunday schema: Sunday II by default, Sunday I after First Vespers. Exact approved-proper review remains pending.

marianChoiceReview.limitation: No texts imported. Existing Latin/unofficial translations and additional conference-approved alternatives still require separate review.

participationOmissionReview.limitation: Christmas requires the Office of Readings vigil, not Midnight Mass alone. Omission does not certify the remaining Triduum or Christmas proper texts.
